observedBuildFlowFromSource: ci/bazel/run.sh resolves checkpoint as the build root and changes into it.
It invokes ci/bazel/bootstrap.py. The bootstrap validates the configured Node version and prepares the private, pinned build toolchain/dependency state.
The wrapper reads .bazelversion, invokes the explicitly supplied absolute Bazel binary for --version, and requires exact version equality.
It invokes the pinned Bazel in batch mode to build //:site, using the wrapper's configured output-user-root selection.
It runs node ci/bazel/verify-output.mjs bazel-bin/site.site bazel-bin/site.receipt.json to verify emitted files against the fresh receipt.
